 Worker in 50s Dies After Fall at Construction Site in Anseong
 Jung Jiyeon 
 Seoul 
 Published 
 2026.11.07 18:51 
 View 
 View Count 
 Enlarge image 
 A worker in his 50s died in an accident today at a construction site for a semiconductor equipment manufacturer in Wongok-myeon, Anseong, Gyeonggi Province. 
 Worker A was reportedly performing welding work on a steel structure when he fell from a height of about 4 meters (13 feet). 
 Worker A was transported to a hospital via helicopter, but ultimately succumbed to his injuries. 
 Police are investigating the exact circumstances of the accident by questioning coworkers who were working alongside Worker A.
